rollups.text: Books and literary activities: On 2023-06-01, attended a Sarah Jones reading, found Jones witty and engaging, and obtained a signed copy of The Lost City; appreciated its atmospheric adventure-and-mystery setting. Considered The Shadow of the Wind and The Night Circus, was interested in more book events, and was thinking of starting a book club with friends and possibly inviting members of a book-lovers Facebook group. The user had attended a book swap and was active in that group. On 2023-06-01, was exploring books and resources about India, especially everyday life and cultural change in the 1960s and 1970s, and asked for recommendations about African American art and Black culture.

Dance and fitness activities: On 2023-05-27, took a salsa class near work with instructor Alex and enjoyed it. On 2023-06-01, preferred beginner salsa classes to build a foundation, planned short home practice sessions using YouTube videos, and was interested in group salsa, hip-hop, and contemporary classes, with weeknight and weekend availability and a hoped-for cost under $20 per class. Also attended Zumba on Thursdays and Pilates on Sundays, enjoyed group fitness, and felt good about fitness progress. Considered beginner yoga on Friday or Saturday and spinning on a separate day or alternating with Pilates; planned to pace workouts. Considered buying a fitness tracker but had not decided.

Theme parks and visits: Visited Europa-Park with colleagues on 2023-05-27..2023-05-28, attended its Oktoberfest and Italian Festival, and rode Blue Fire, which the user thought was amazing. As of 2023-06-01, had tracked 12 theme-park visits in 2023 and aimed for 15 by year-end. Was planning to attend Alton Towers Halloween Party on 2023-10-27, considering Efteling and PortAventura World before year-end, planning a Germany trip, and interested in Phantasialand and its Wintertraum event. The user is a thrill-ride fan and wanted a theme-park bucket list.

Homemade and garden products sold or considered: On 2023-05-15, sold 12 bunches of backyard-grown fresh organic herbs at a farmers’ market for $120. On 2023-05-29, sold 15 jars of homemade jam at the Homemade and Handmade Market for $225. By 2023-06-01, made homemade jam and spice blends and was considering autumn gift baskets named “Harvest Delight,” combining jam, spice blends, and nuts; selected promotional copy for the baskets. Also sold 20 potted herb plants at the Summer Solstice Market for $7.50 each, earning $150, and considered expanding to herbal teas and spice blends. For a future Harvest Festival Market, identified herbal teas and herb-infused oils as possible products, and considered herbal skincare such as face creams and body lotions.

Product-business development timeline: On 2023-05-15, sold 12 bunches of backyard-grown organic herbs at a farmers’ market for $120. On 2023-05-29, sold 15 jars of homemade jam for $225. By 2023-06-01, was considering complementary products for upcoming markets: herbal teas, herb-infused oils, and later herbal skincare. Planned to learn herb drying and preservation, check labeling and packaging guidance, research competitive pricing, and study skincare formulation, good manufacturing practices, and regulations. The records do not establish that these plans were completed. The earliest and latest dated steps are 17 days apart.

Art interests and activities: On 2023-05-27, visited the Metropolitan Museum of Art’s “Women in Art” exhibition, felt inspired to make art, was especially moved by Frida Kahlo’s self-portraits, and was drawn to Georgia O’Keeffe’s bold, colorful flower paintings. By 2023-06-01, was particularly interested in beginner watercolor, layering, wet-on-wet techniques, symbolism, and the Mexican cultural and historical context of Kahlo’s work; planned to explore resources. Also expressed interest in O’Keeffe’s style and techniques.

Watercolor and art-learning thread: On 2023-05-27, the user visited the Metropolitan Museum of Art’s “Women in Art” exhibition, felt inspired to make art, and was moved by Frida Kahlo’s self-portraits; Georgia O’Keeffe’s colorful flower paintings also caught the user’s attention. By 2023-06-01, the user was interested in beginner watercolor supplies, layering and wet-on-wet techniques, symbolism in Kahlo’s art, and Mexican folklore, mythology, and historical context. The user said they would check recommended resources and begin exploring symbolism. The dated steps span five days.

Bicycles and cycling equipment: The user owns a Trek FX 3 and had had it for about three years by 2023-06-01. In May 2023, lent it to friend Alex for a week; Alex returned it with a flat tire. On 2023-05-27..2023-05-28, bought a shiny blue bicycle helmet for about $40. By 2023-06-01, was considering servicing the bike, addressing worn pedals, deciding whether to clean or replace its chain, and buying a Thule car bike rack priced around $150; also planned to register the bike with local police.

Social media and phone-use activities: By 2023-06-01, the user was active on WhatsApp, exchanging an estimated 30–40 messages daily, especially with cousins planning a family reunion. The user was experimenting with Instagram Stories’ Question sticker, used Close Friends for exclusive content, and was considering a second private Instagram account. Also wanted to organize social media use, limit screen time before bed, and find an app to track use against a daily phone-time limit set about a month earlier. The user had organized phone storage and was considering Google Photos and automatic backups; the user had recently been taking many photos and noticed faster battery drain.

Morning routine and wake-up goal: On 2023-06-01, the user reported waking at 6:30 AM about 70% of the time and said they were not yet a morning person. The existing routine included stretching and meditation. The user planned to try a Philips Wake-Up Light, considering a 15-minute light period that could gradually increase to 30 minutes or longer; no final duration was chosen. These steps were discussed on the same date.

Chicago condo exploration: On 2023-06-01, the user was looking to buy a downtown Chicago condo and supplied an annual gross income of $85,000, credit score around 750, savings of about 20% for a down payment, loan payments totaling around 10% of monthly income, and no high-interest debt. The user was especially interested in West Loop and South Loop, prioritizing transit, relatively low crime, car-free living, and school quality because they hoped to start a family within a few years. The assistant gave a rough affordability estimate and neighborhood comparisons; no purchase or final neighborhood choice was reported. The planning discussion occurred on one date.

Vegan banana-bread experimentation: On 2023-06-01, the user said they had made vegan banana bread three times in the previous two weeks and thought the recipe was perfected. The user wanted to try different flours, chose oat flour as the first experiment, planned to grind oats already at home, and wanted to experiment with gluten-free baking. The user also considered adding spices and asked which would complement banana. The flour and spice plans had not yet been tested in the records.

Theme-park visits: The user’s spreadsheet recorded 12 total theme-park visits in 2023 as of 2023-06-01. The user’s goal was 15 visits by 2023-12-31, implying three additional visits were needed at that point. A later total is not recorded.

Market sales recorded: On 2023-05-15, sold 12 bunches of fresh organic herbs for $120 total; on 2023-05-29, sold 15 jars of homemade jam for $225; on 2023-06-01, reported selling 20 potted herb plants for $150 total at the Summer Solstice Market.
